connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source:
A connection to the [Stability AI](https://stability.ai) REST API for image generation and editing, audio, and 3D assets.

Requires an API key for Bearer authentication.  Get your API key from the [Stability AI dashboard](https://platform.stability.ai).
connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message:
Una connessione all'API REST di [Stability AI](https://stability.ai) per la generazione e l'editing di immagini, audio e asset 3D.

Richiede una chiave API per l'autenticazione Bearer. Ottieni la tua chiave API dal [dashboard di Stability AI](https://platform.stability.ai).

connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: The Stability AI API key used for Bearer authentication.
connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: La chiave API di Stability AI utilizzata per l'autenticazione Bearer.
Chiave API di Stability AI (token Bearer)

connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: Optional organization ID from the authenticated account's organizations. Omit it to use the API key's default organization.
connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: ID dell'organizzazione opzionale dall'account autenticato. Ometterlo per utilizzare l'organizzazione predefinita associata alla chiave API.

connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: Organization whose credits and resources are used
connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: Organizzazione i cui crediti e risorse vengono utilizzati

connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: Authenticated access to Stability AI media services
connection.U3RhYmlsaXR5QWlSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: Accesso autenticato ai servizi multimediali di Stability AI
